name: Scharr 梯度分析
description: 计算Scharr梯度以进行边缘分析，检测AI生成图像中的边缘异常 (2000)
algorithm: Scharr Gradient — 像素级空间分析
mechanism:
This method applies the Scharr gradient operator for image forensic analysis:

1. **ScharrOperatorApplication**: The 3×3 Scharr kernels are applied in horizontal and vertical directions. The Scharr operator provides improved rotational symmetry compared to Sobel, with kernel weights [−3,0,3; −10,0,10; −3,0,3] for the horizontal direction, yielding more accurate gradient estimation.

2. **梯度幅度分布**: The distribution of Scharr gradient magnitudes across the image is analyzed. Natural images show characteristic gradient magnitude distributions shaped by the optical transfer function and scene content. AI-generated images may show different distributions — modified high-frequency content or gradient magnitude statistics inconsistent with optical imaging.

3. **梯度Direction分析**: The gradient direction field θ = arctan(Gy/Gx) reveals edge orientations. The method analyzes direction distributions and directional coherence. AI-generated images may show direction field anomalies — grid-aligned gradient biases from convolutional architectures or direction distributions not matching scene geometry.

4. **局部梯度Statistics**: Per-region Scharr gradient statistics (mean, variance, skewness, kurtosis) are computed. Spatial variation in gradient statistics should follow scene content. The method detects regions where gradient statistics are inconsistent with neighboring regions — indicating potential manipulation boundaries.

5. **梯度Feature评分**: Scharr gradient features (magnitude distribution, directional statistics, spatial consistency, scale behavior) are combined into a forensic score measuring conformity with natural image gradient characteristics versus AI generation artifacts.
parameters:
分析类型: 像素
媒体: 图像
输入: 原始像素数据 / 图像文件
输出: 置信度分数 (0-100)
处理方式: 客户端 Canvas API
色彩空间: RGB、灰度（视情况而定）
accuracy: 中到高 — 70-90% 独立准确率. 在未压缩图像上性能最佳 and 在重度JPEG压缩或社交媒体重新编码时可能降低.
source: 数字图像取证研究。基于信号处理和计算摄影原理.
useCase: 通过以下方式检测AI生成或篡改的图像： scharr gradient 分析。该方法识别AI生成特有的模式和伪影，为全面的图像取证分析做出贡献.
strengths:
• 使用 Canvas API 快速客户端处理
• 有效检测特定的AI生成伪影
• 支持常见图像格式（JPEG、PNG、WebP）
• 可与互补的分析方法组合使用
• 基于成熟的图像取证研究
limitations:
• 性能可能因图像压缩级别而异
• 社交媒体重新编码可能影响准确性
• 最好与其他取证方法结合使用
• 对经过大量处理的真实图像可能产生误报
• 有效性取决于所使用的AI生成模型

references.title: Gonzalez, R.C. & Woods, R.E. (2018). Digital Image Processing. 4th Edition. Pearson.
Canny, J. (1986). A Computational Approach to Edge Detection. IEEE TPAMI.
